page.overview:
What is Mortal Kombat: Onslaught?

Mortal Kombat: Onslaught is a Mortal Kombat mobile RPG.

The game is described as a collection role-playing game where players build a roster of fighters from the Mortal Kombat universe and "unleash them in massive real-time group battles." The game features a cinematic story experience where fighters have to defeat "a dark and dangerous threat."

The game is set in an alternate timeline and features many recurring characters, both old and new. On July 18, 2024, it was announced the game will cease operations and close later in October of 2024.

Summon legendary fighters and lead your team to victory in massive RPG battles!
